## Figure 1a

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(sf); library(rnaturalearth); library(rnaturalearthdata); library(ggrepel)

meta <- meta %>% mutate(Status = str_trim(Status), Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Pristine Freshwater", "Pristine Salty Estuary", "Contaminated")))
country_labels <- tibble(Country = c("Sweden", "Germany", "Switzerland", "Spain", "Greece"), Longitude = c(18.5, 13.5, 8.7, 2.5, 22.8), Latitude = c(61.0, 53.5, 48.0, 42.3, 41.0))

plot_sites <- meta %>% mutate(X_plot = Longitude, Y_plot = Latitude)
plot_sites <- plot_sites %>% mutate(X_plot = case_when(Site == "Uerke Upstream" ~ Longitude - 0.25, 
                                                       Site == "Uerke Downstream" ~ Longitude + 0.25,
                                                       Site == "Tegeler Fliess Upstream" ~ Longitude - 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Tegeler Fliess Downstream" ~ Longitude + 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Gallikos Upstream" ~ Longitude - 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Gallikos Downstream" ~ Longitude + 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Vitsån Upstream" ~ Longitude - 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Vitsån Downstream" ~ Longitude + 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Knivstaån Upstream" ~ Longitude - 0.20,
                                                       Site == "Knivstaån Downstream" ~ Longitude + 0.20,
                                                       TRUE ~ Longitude),
                                    Y_plot = case_when(Site == "Uerke Upstream" ~ Latitude + 0.08,
                                                       Site == "Uerke Downstream" ~ Latitude - 0.08,
                                                       
                                                       Site == "Tegeler Fliess Upstream" ~ Latitude + 0.08,
                                                       Site == "Tegeler Fliess Downstream" ~ Latitude - 0.08,
                                                       Site == "Gallikos Upstream" ~ Latitude + 0.06,
                                                       Site == "Gallikos Downstream" ~ Latitude - 0.06,
                                                       Site == "Vitsån Upstream" ~ Latitude + 0.06,
                                                       Site == "Vitsån Downstream" ~ Latitude - 0.06,
                                                       Site == "Knivstaån Upstream" ~ Latitude + 0.06,
                                                       Site == "Knivstaån Downstream" ~ Latitude - 0.06,
                                                       TRUE ~ Latitude))

# Europe map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Figure 1A
ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#CFE3D0", colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +  
           geom_text(data = country_labels, aes(Longitude, Latitude, label = Country), size = 5, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.45) +
           geom_segment(data = plot_sites, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, xend = X_plot, yend = Y_plot), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
           geom_point(data = plot_sites, aes(X_plot, Y_plot, fill = Status), shape = 21, size = 2.2, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
           geom_text_repel(data = plot_sites, aes(X_plot, Y_plot, label = Site), seed = 123, size = 3.2, box.padding = 1, point.padding = 0.8, force = 50,
                           max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50") +
           scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pristine Freshwater" = "#4575B4", "Pristine Salty Estuary" = "#1A9850", "Contaminated" = "#D73027"), drop = FALSE) +
           coord_sf(xlim = c(-6, 29), ylim = c(38, 62.5), expand = FALSE) + labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", fill = "Site category") +
           theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "right",
                                            legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Figure 1c-d

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(patchwork)

fig1c <- ggplot(seq, aes(`bbcms reads` / 1e6)) + geom_density(fill = "#74A9CF", colour = "#2B5C8A", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) +
         geom_rug(sides = "b", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_vline(xintercept = median(seq$`bbcms reads` / 1e6), colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "High-quality non-human reads (millions)", y = "Density") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig1d <- ggplot(seq, aes(`total contig length` / 1e6)) + geom_density(fill = "#66C2A5", colour = "#238B45", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) +
         geom_rug(sides = "b", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_vline(xintercept = median(seq$`total contig length` / 1e6), colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "Contig assembly size (Mb)", y = "Density") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig1e <- ggplot(seq, aes(N50)) + geom_histogram(bins = 8, fill = "#FDB863", colour = "#E08214", alpha = 0.8) + 
         geom_vline(xintercept = median(seq$N50), colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + labs(x = "N50 (bp)", y = "No. of samples") +
         theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig1f <- ggplot(seq, aes(`GC (%)`)) + geom_histogram(bins = 8, fill = "#BC80BD", colour = "#7A0177", alpha = 0.8) +
         geom_vline(xintercept = median(seq$`GC (%)`), colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "GC content (%)", y = "No. of samples") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig1_cf <- ( fig1c | fig1d | fig1e | fig1f ) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("c", "d", "e", "f")))
fig1_cf
```

## Figure 2a-d

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(patchwork)

fig2a <- ggplot(mags, aes(completeness)) + geom_density(fill = "#1B9E77", colour = "#006D5B", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) + geom_rug(sides = "b", alpha = 0.6) +
         geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         geom_vline(xintercept = 90, colour = "#238B45", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "Completeness (%)", y = "Density") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig2b <- ggplot(mags, aes(contamination)) + geom_density(fill = "#D95F02", colour = "#A63603", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) +
         geom_rug(sides = "b", alpha = 0.6) + geom_vline(xintercept = 5, colour = "#238B45", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
         geom_vline(xintercept = 10, colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "Contamination (%)", y = "Density") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig2c <- ggplot(mags, aes(size / 1e6, completeness)) + geom_point(colour = "#E7298A", alpha = 0.75, size = 2.3) +
         geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#C51B7D", linewidth = 0.9) + geom_hline(yintercept = 50, colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
         labs(x = "MAG size (Mb)", y = "Completeness (%)") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig2d <- ggplot(mags, aes(GC * 100, completeness)) + geom_point(colour = "#7570B3", alpha = 0.75, size = 2.3) +
         geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#54278F", linewidth = 0.9) +
         geom_hline(yintercept = 50, colour = "#D73027", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + labs(x = "GC content (%)", y = "Completeness (%)") +
         theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig2 <- (fig2a | fig2b) / (fig2c | fig2d) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b", "c", "d"))) & 
        theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16), plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))

fig2
```

## Figure 2e-g

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(patchwork)

mags_qc <- mags %>% mutate(Quality = case_when(completeness >= 90 & contamination <= 5 ~ "High quality", completeness >= 50 & contamination <= 10 ~ "Medium quality", TRUE ~ "Low quality"))
quality_counts <- mags_qc %>% count(Quality) %>% mutate(Quality = factor(Quality, levels = c("High quality", "Medium quality", "Low quality")))

fig2e <- ggplot(quality_counts, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = Quality)) + geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "white") +
         geom_text(aes(label = n),  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4) + coord_flip() +
         scale_fill_manual(values = c("High quality" = "#238B45", "Medium quality" = "#74A9CF", "Low quality" = "#D73027")) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of MAGs") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

domain_counts <- mags %>% mutate(Domain = gsub("^d__", "", Domain)) %>% count(Domain)

fig2f <- ggplot(domain_counts, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = Domain)) + geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "white") +
         geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4) + coord_flip() +
         scale_fill_manual(values = c("Bacteria" = "#4C78A8",  "Archaea" = "#F58518")) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of MAGs") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

tax_depth <- tibble(Rank = c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), 
                    Count = c(sum(mags$Phylum != "p__"), sum(mags$Class != "c__"), sum(mags$Order != "o__"), sum(mags$Family != "f__"), sum(mags$Genus != "g__"), sum(mags$Species != "s__")))
tax_depth$Rank <- factor(tax_depth$Rank, levels = c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"))

fig2g <- ggplot(tax_depth, aes(Rank, Count)) + geom_col(fill = "gray75", colour = "gray50", width = 0.8) + geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = -0.25, size = 4) +
         scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 200), breaks = seq(0, 200, 50)) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Classified MAGs") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig2_eg <- (fig2e / fig2f / fig2g) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1), heights = c(1,1,2.5))
fig2_eg
```

## Figure 3

```{r}
library(ape); library(phytools); library(ggtree); library(ggtreeExtra); library(ggnewscale); library(paletteer); library(tidyverse)

tree <- read.tree("gtdbtk.bac120.user_msa.tree"); tree <- midpoint.root(tree)

# Metadata
metadata <- mags %>% filter(Domain == "d__Bacteria") %>%
            mutate(Quality = case_when(completeness >= 90 & contamination <= 5 ~ "High quality", completeness >= 50 & contamination <= 10 ~ "Medium quality", TRUE ~ "Low quality"),
            Phylum = gsub("^p__", "", Phylum), Genome_size = pmin(size / 1e6, 8))

metadata <- metadata[ match(tree$tip.label, metadata$bin), ]
phyla <- sort(unique(metadata$Phylum)); phyla_cols <- setNames(rev(colorRampPalette(paletteer_d("ggthemes::Classic_10"))(length(phyla))), phyla)

# Base tree
p <- ggtree(tree, layout = "fan", open.angle = 90, size = 0.08, colour = "grey60"); p$data <- merge(p$data, metadata, by.x = "label", by.y = "bin", all.x = TRUE)

# Phylum tip colours
p <- p + geom_tippoint(aes(fill = Phylum, colour = Phylum), shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = phyla_cols) +  scale_colour_manual(values = phyla_cols, guide = "none")

# Ring 1 : Phylum
p <- p + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + geom_fruit(geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(fill = Phylum), width = 0.08, offset = 0.08, color = NA) +
         scale_fill_manual(name = "Phylum", values = phyla_cols)

# Ring 2 : Completeness
p <- p + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + geom_fruit(geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(fill = completeness), width = 0.08, offset = 0.08, color = NA) +
         scale_fill_gradient(name = "Completeness (%)", low = "#FFEDA0", high = "#F03B20")

# Ring 3 : MAG quality
p <- p + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + geom_fruit(geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(fill = Quality), width = 0.08, offset = 0.08, color = NA) +
         scale_fill_manual(name = "MAG quality", values = c("High quality" = "#238B45", "Medium quality" = "#74A9CF", "Low quality" = "#D73027"))

# Outer track : Genome size (Mbp)
p <- p + geom_fruit(geom = geom_bar, mapping = aes(y = label, x = Genome_size), stat = "identity", orientation = "y", pwidth = 0.4, offset = 0.08,
                    fill = "#D9D9D9", colour = NA, axis.params = list(axis = "x", text.size = 2, limits = c(0, 8), nbreak = 3), grid.params = list(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.05))

# Theme
p <- p + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

# Plot
p
```

## Figure 4a

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(pheatmap)

sample_cols <- grep("^M\\d{3}$", names(mags), value = TRUE)

# Top 30 most abundant MAGs
top30 <- mags %>% mutate(MeanAbundance = rowMeans(select(., all_of(sample_cols)))) %>% arrange(desc(MeanAbundance)) %>% slice_head(n = 30)

# Abundance matrix
abund <- top30 %>% select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>% as.data.frame(); rownames(abund) <- top30$MAG; abund[] <- lapply(abund,as.numeric)
abund_log <- log10(as.matrix(abund) + 0.01)

# Row annotation
anno_row <- data.frame(Phylum = factor(gsub("^p__", "", top30$Phylum))); rownames(anno_row) <- top30$MAG

# Column annotation
anno_col <- meta %>% select(Sample, Country, Status) %>% as.data.frame(); rownames(anno_col) <- anno_col$Sample
anno_col <- anno_col[sample_cols, c("Country", "Status")]
anno_col$Country <- factor(anno_col$Country); anno_col$Status  <- factor(anno_col$Status)

phylum_cols <- c("Acidobacteriota" = "#2CB1BC", "Actinomycetota" = "#8CBF56", "Bacteroidota" = "#A7A742", "Chloroflexota" = "#8D858C", "Cyanobacteriota" = "#C06FAF",
                 "Desulfobacterota" = "#B5678E", "Gemmatimonadota" = "#946062", "Myxococcota" = "#9468B3", "Myxococcota_A" = "#B64573", "Nitrospinota" = "#B54423",
                 "Nitrospirota" = "#3A9D23", "Planctomycetota" = "#B79618", "Pseudomonadota" = "#C18442", "Verrucomicrobiota" = "#2B79B7")

# Keep only phyla present in top30
phylum_cols <- phylum_cols[ names(phylum_cols) %in% levels(anno_row$Phylum) ]
country_cols <- c("Switzerland" = "#1B9E77", "Germany" = "#D95F02", "Spain" = "#7570B3", "Greece" = "#E7298A", "Sweden" = "#66A61E")
status_cols <- c("Pristine Freshwater" = "#4575B4", "Pristine Salty Estuary" = "#1A9850", "Contaminated" = "#D73027")
anno_colors <- list(Phylum  = phylum_cols, Country = country_cols, Status  = status_cols)

pheatmap(abund_log, color = colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#C6DBEF", "#6BAED6", "#2171B5", "#08306B"))(100), annotation_row = anno_row, annotation_col = anno_col, annotation_colors = anno_colors,
         clustering_method = "ward.D2", border_color = NA, show_rownames = FALSE, fontsize_col = 10, treeheight_row = 40, treeheight_col = 40, angle_col = 45, main = "Top 30 most abundant MAGs")
```

## Figure 4b

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(ggplot2)

sample_cols <- grep("^M\\d{3}$", names(mags), value = TRUE)

abund <- mags %>% select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>% as.matrix(); mode(abund) <- "numeric"; abund_t <- t(log10(abund + 0.01))

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(abund_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE); var_exp <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)
pca_df <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(pca$x), PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2]) %>% left_join(meta, by = "Sample")
country_cols <- c("Switzerland" = "#1B9E77", "Germany" = "#D95F02", "Spain" = "#7570B3", "Greece" = "#E7298A", "Sweden" = "#66A61E")

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Country, shape = Status)) + geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) + scale_colour_manual(values = country_cols) +
labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")) + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank())
```

## Figure 4c

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(ggplot2)

sample_cols <- grep("^M\\d{3}$", names(mags), value = TRUE)

# MAG prevalence
prev_df <- mags %>% mutate(Prevalence = rowSums(select(., all_of(sample_cols)) > 0))

fig4c <- ggplot(prev_df, aes(Prevalence)) + geom_histogram(bins = 19, fill = "#4C78A8", colour = "#2F4B7C", alpha = 0.85) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:19) +
         labs(x = "Number of samples containing MAG", y = "Number of MAGs") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
         theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig4c
```
